title: Formation Organisation Charts (SPI 19.31 Commonwealth, 19.32 Italian, 19.33 German)

any_of.description: The chart's 'X or Y': one of these

type.description: Organisation type of a component that is itself a formation on this chart

sp.description: Stacking points printed beside each such counter on the chart (a formation's are in parentheses); null where the chart prints the symbol with no figure

counts_for_shell.description: Whether 9.26 counts this component when judging the parent a shell (R-141): in a division, components of 2 SP or more; in a brigade or regiment, components of 1 SP or more; never a component of 0 SP or with no figure

units.description: Unit slugs used in components, with what each stands for in our words (the chart's symbol key)

part_slots.description: Slots a counter can fill together with others of its kind (an OA counter's fills_part, R-142): a slot holds up to parts such counters and is filled once min of them are in it; one counter that fills the slot alone (fills) fills it outright

sp.description: Stacking points of the parent counter

type.description: Organisation type, where the chart splits a formation by period

turns.description: Game-Turns the row applies in; a type that applies in two separate periods is given as two rows
